scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@scmp/shared && npm run build --workspace=@scmp/server && npm run build --workspace=@scmp/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@scmp/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@scmp/client"
